text: No, the property did not lose tree cover in 2019. While Hansen’s data flagged 1.8 ha (0.05% of the asset) as lost, the independent JRC 2020 reference map shows 0% agreement with that area being non-forest. The detected loss did not meet the 0.5 ha minimum threshold and was contradicted by later-year observations. The MGAP 2021 map confirms the area was planted forest (Pinus spp.), but no structural change was validated. The evidence supports no loss event.
